dog.description_text:
Meet Bambi, a sweet and loving girl who is ready for her next big adventure!

At just 4 months old, Bambi was found abandoned at a precinct, visibly malnourished and scared.

Fast forward to today, and just look at this girl! Bambi has learned SO much through her training this year. She's incredibly smart, eager to learn, and one of the most loyal dogs you'll meet. Once she loves you, she loves you BIG. She's affectionate, cuddly, and always happy to soak up some quality time with her favorite humans. And don't even get us started on her nose! Her scent work is so impressive you'd think she was secretly training for the K-9 unit. Seriously, someone give this girl a badge!

Bambi is also a huge fan of other dogs and absolutely loves having a playful friend around. Her dream home would include another fun-loving pup to run, play, and get into all sorts of adventures with. She's the kind of dog who would make a wonderful family companion, especially for an active family that enjoys walks, outdoor adventures, playtime, and keeping curious minds busy.

Bambi has come such a long way, and now it's time for her to enjoy everything life has to offer. She's ready to be someone's loyal best friend, adventure buddy, cuddle companion, and forever girl. If you're looking for a smart, loving pup who will bring endless joy to your home, Bambi might just be your perfect match!

Please fill out and submit an adoption application today!
